prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Test Pet Voice", "Test Your Pet's Voice & Sounds", "Click below to sample how your companion will speak and react on your desktop.", "Play Happy Bark", "Finish Setup"]
1: ["Master Desktop Controls", "Practice hiding and summoning your pet so you can manage desktop space anytime.", "Got It, Bring Pet Home"]
2: ["Preparing Your Pet's Desktop Workspace", "Synthesizing vocalization patterns and building companion animations for your desktop environment."]
3: ["Choose Your Companion Journey", "Scroll to discover distinct companion paths tailored for work, relaxation, or play."]
4: ["Sign In to Sync & Save Your Companion", "Your account links your pet's memory, items, and settings safely to cloud backup."]
5: []
6: ["Your Companion is Ready on Desktop", "Try out primary actions below before placing your companion on your screen.", "Call Pet to Cursor", "Open Companion Menu"]
7: ["Pick Your Friend & Unlock Exclusive Accents", "Select a companion base to unlock unique fur and accessory color themes.", "Bonus Accent Pack Unlocked"]
8: ["Tip: Use the same provider (Google, Apple, or Email) you used previously to keep existing pets."]
9: ["Customize Idle Animations", "Choose Idle Behaviors", "Pick how your companion behaves when idling on your screen while you work.", "Select Idle Style", "Save & Continue Waiting"]
